acceptanceCriteria.text: The new test passes and pins ownership, survival of the prune, revision-1 hash integrity, re-adding to the same ticket, and refusal on another ticket.
The ADR and the module header state the rule.

body:
Images a later saved revision drops stay owned by their ticket (src/core/services/ticketAttachments.ts:149-155 only claims). That is correct and must stay: earlier saved revisions name the ref and their contentHash covers it; repo-mode snapshots and epics/<id>/attachments files reference it (src/core/repo/attachmentFiles.ts:164); import re-owns every image any saved revision names (src/core/repo/attachmentImport.ts:225-250), so releasing would make machines disagree; and the prune (src/core/services/attachments.ts:274-285) would delete bytes history still shows. Re-adding to the same ticket works (ticketAttachments.ts:60-62,87,136), other records are refused, and a dropped image does not count toward the per-revision limit (:122). What is missing is a test and the written rule.

## Do
1. src/core/services/ticketAttachments.ts:1-5 header comment: add "An image a later revision drops stays owned by its ticket: earlier saved revisions, their content hashes, repo-mode snapshots and imports still name it. It is never pruned, may be shown on the same ticket again, and is refused on any other ticket or record."
2. docs/decisions/0006-image-attachments.md: after the "Where an image attaches" bullet (lines 24-27), add a bullet "A ticket keeps the images it showed." saying the same and citing import re-owning from saved revisions.
3. No production logic changes.

## Out of scope
Releasing or deleting dropped images; a garbage collector for history images; StorageCard counts.

## Tests
src/core/services/ticketAttachments.test.ts, new describe('images a later revision dropped'), one test: stage x, set it on refMap.a, saveNow; set [], saveNow. Expect ownerOf(ctx, x) to equal refMap.a; pruneStagedAttachments(ctx, '9999-01-01T00:00:00.000Z') returns 0 and getAttachment still finds x; getPlan({ view: 'saved', revisionId: <rev1> }) still lists x on ticket a and contentHash(thatBundle) equals that view's contentHash; setImages(ctx, epicId, refMap.a, [x]) succeeds; editRefusal(ctx, epicId, refMap.b, [x]) is 'conflict'.

## Rules
This card is the complete fix: nothing it finds is left for a later card. Fix anything that blocks a criterion inside this card. Run the listed tests, `npm run typecheck`, and `npx oxlint` on the touched files.
title: Pin and document that a ticket keeps images a later revision dropped
